**Timeless Way Interactive, LLC**

---

This Work Pool Contribution and Assignment (this "Assignment") is made as of
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (the "Contribution Date") between **Timeless Way Interactive, LLC**,
a Texas limited liability company (the "Company"), and \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (the
"Contributing Member").

## **Background**

The Contributing Member is a Member of the Company and has created the project described
in Schedule 1 (the "Project"). Section 7.2 of the Operating Agreement lets a Member
contribute a project they have created into the Work Pool, at that Member's sole
discretion and on the Committee's acceptance. The Committee accepted the Project on
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_. This Assignment is the instrument that moves ownership.

## **1. Assignment**

The Contributing Member hereby irrevocably assigns, transfers, and conveys to the Company,
throughout the world and for the full term of each right (including all renewals,
extensions, and reversions), all right, title, and interest in and to the Project,
including all copyrights, trademarks and the goodwill they symbolize, trade secrets,
patent rights, moral rights (waived to the extent they cannot be assigned), domain names,
and every other intellectual property right in it, together with all causes of action for
past, present, and future infringement and all proceeds of them.

The Project becomes Company IP on the Contribution Date, owned by the Company and held in
trust for the equal benefit of all Members (Sections 7.1, 7.2).

## **2. Irreversibility**

Contribution is irreversible (Section 7.2). The Contributing Member retains no ownership
interest in the Project and holds instead the perpetual license of Section 7.3, on the
same terms as every other Member. Nothing in this Assignment is undone by the Contributing
Member's later resignation, expulsion, death, or incapacity.

## **3. Representations**

The Contributing Member represents and warrants that, as of the Contribution Date:

1.  they own the Project outright and have full authority to assign it;
2.  the Project carries no security interest, lien, pledge, or other encumbrance, and has
    never been offered as collateral for any obligation (Section 9.4);
3.  no third party holds or claims an ownership interest in the Project, and no
    contributor retains rights in it (Section 3.7);
4.  the Project does not, to the Contributing Member's knowledge, infringe any third
    party's rights; and
5.  Schedule 2 discloses every third-party, marketplace, open-source, and AI-generated
    component in the Project and the license terms each is held on, and is complete and
    accurate to the Contributing Member's knowledge.

These representations are made in the Contributing Member's personal capacity. They are
not a guarantee of title against the world, and a good-faith error in Schedule 2 is
corrected by amending the manifest, not by unwinding the contribution.

## **4. Third-Party Components**

Components disclosed in Schedule 2 are assigned only to the extent the Contributing Member
holds assignable rights in them. Where a component is held on third-party terms that do
not permit assignment or do not permit a Member's use under Section 7.3, this Assignment
does not enlarge those terms; the manifest under Section 10.1 records the limitation, and
every delivery under clause 7 of Section 7.3 carries that manifest.

## **5. Further Assurances**

The Contributing Member will, at the Company's expense, execute any further document
reasonably needed to perfect or record the Company's ownership — including assignments
recordable with the United States Copyright Office or the United States Patent and
Trademark Office — and will transfer custody of repositories, source files, accounts, and
credentials for the Project to the Company.

## **6. General**

This Assignment is governed by Texas law and is subject in all respects to the Operating
Agreement; where they conflict, the Operating Agreement governs. It may be signed in
counterparts, including electronically. Terms defined in the Operating Agreement have the
same meaning here.
